userProfile.title: User Profile
userProfile.description: Details of the user's account, active status, and custom Spark simulation credit data.

displayName.description: Displays name of the authenticated user.

isAnonymous.description: Determines if signed in as guest observer.

credits.description: Remaining free tier mockup query credits.

designBoard.title: Design Board
designBoard.description: The generated interior design board, analyzed suggestions, layout coordinates, and shopping list.

id.description: ID of the design board document.

userId.description: ID of the user who requested the redesign.

roomType.description: The type of interior room (e.g., Living Room, Bedroom, Kitchen).

style.description: Target aesthetic style (e.g., Swiss-Minimalist, Japandi, Nordic, Industrial).

originalImage.description: Client-pre-compressed base64 thumbnail or placeholder path.

redesignedImage.description: Reference link to reconstructed interactive render.

colorPalette.description: Primary Hex codes or colors in Slovak (JSON serialized or simple listing).

analysisText.description: Summary of spatial suggestions, lighting improvements, and structural edits organized in Slovak.

shoppingList.description: JSON representation of suggested furniture items with placement coordinates and Slovak store references to fit Spark limits.
